title: "Tyvaso ATS"
format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(openintro)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
#Read In CSVs
tyvaso_gx_ats <- read_csv("/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/tyvaso_gx_new.csv")
tyvaso_spect_ats <- read_csv("/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/tyvaso_spect_new.csv")
```

```{r}
tyvaso_combined_ats <- full_join(tyvaso_gx_ats, tyvaso_spect_ats, by = "subject_id")
```

```{r}
#Create Timepoint and Subject Variable for gx and spect data and corrected oscillations
tyvaso_combined_ats_transformed <- tyvaso_combined_ats |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_detect(subject_id, "s1") ~ "Baseline",
      str_detect(subject_id, "s2") ~ "15 Min",
      str_detect(subject_id, "s3") ~ "3 Hours",
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c("Baseline", "15 Min", "3 Hours")
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(timepoint, .after = 1) |>
  mutate(subject = sub("_s[123]", "", subject_id)) |>
  relocate(subject, .after = 1) |> 
  mutate(f_corr = 10.5/((3.73/vc_rel) + 6.76),
         corr_osc_amp_peaks = osc_amp_peaks * f_corr)
```

```{r}
#Get rid of low snr subject
tyvaso_combined_ats_spaghetti <- tyvaso_combined_ats_transformed|>
  filter(!subject %in% c(
    "006-108"))
```

```{r}
#Create deltas for the variables
tyvaso_delta <- tyvaso_combined_ats_spaghetti |>
  group_by(subject) |>
  mutate(
    rbc_delta = rbc_shift - rbc_shift[timepoint == "Baseline"][1],
    vc_rel_delta = vc_rel - vc_rel[timepoint == "Baseline"][1],
    corr_osc_amp_delta = corr_osc_amp_peaks - corr_osc_amp_peaks[timepoint == "Baseline"][1]
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
#Make spaghetti plot for timepoints and rbc shift
ggplot(tyvaso_delta,
       aes(x = timepoint,
           y = rbc_delta,
           group = subject,
           color = subject)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(alpha = 1) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1, linetype = "Cohort average (n=10)"),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Cohort average (n=10)" = "solid")
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "RBC Shift Change from Baseline",
    x = "",
    y = "Change in RBC Shift (ppm)"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.03, 0.97),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13)
  )
```

```{r}
# Plot global variables
ggplot(tyvaso_combined_ats_spaghetti, aes(x = vc_rel, y = rbc_shift)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.3, color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "#3B6B8F",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Relative V"[C]),
    y = "RBC Shift (ppm)",
    title = expression("Relationship Between Relative V"[C] * " and RBC Shift")
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian()
```

```{r}
#Get correlation coefficient
cor.test(
  tyvaso_combined_ats_spaghetti$vc_rel,
  tyvaso_combined_ats_spaghetti$rbc_shift
)
```

```{r}
#Create delta vc rel
tyvaso_combined_vc_wide <- tyvaso_combined_ats_spaghetti |>
  select(subject, timepoint, vc_rel) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = subject,
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = vc_rel
  ) |>
  mutate(
    delta_vc_rel = `15 Min` - Baseline,
    delta_vc_rel_3hr = `3 Hours` - Baseline
  )
```

```{r}
#Get summary statistics for the delta_vc_rel
tyvaso_combined_vc_wide|>
  select(delta_vc_rel, delta_vc_rel_3hr) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(delta_vc_rel, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(delta_vc_rel, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(delta_vc_rel, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_3hr =mean(delta_vc_rel_3hr, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#Create Q-Q plot to see if it follows a normal distribution
qqnorm(tyvaso_combined_vc_wide$delta_vc_rel)
qqline(tyvaso_combined_vc_wide$delta_vc_rel)
```

```{r}
#paired t-test for 15 min where average change is comparaed to 0
t.test(tyvaso_combined_vc_wide$delta_vc_rel, mu = 0)
```

```{r}
#paired t-test for 3 hrs where average change is comparaed to 0
t.test(tyvaso_combined_vc_wide$delta_vc_rel_3hr, mu = 0)
```
